# Source fixtures for warehouse integration

`comext_cobalt_2023.json` preserves one original bounded German Comext response captured on 30 October 2026, including native partner aggregates and both flows. The adjacent metadata file records its original query, acquisition time, fingerprint and source rights. Source: Eurostat, DS-045409, accessed 30 October 2026. Original bytes are unchanged. Reuse policy: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/help/copyright-notice.

The CI capture also uses the attributed original IEA samples under data/sample/iea. CI manifests explicitly identify fixture import; they are not new live API requests or evidence of new upstream data. No source values are generated. Any deliberately modified data in regression tests are temporary test inputs, not published observations.
